description: Land Title Settlement Department - Gotabhayapura, Thissamaharamaya D/S Division, Hambantota District - Cad. Map No. 830078
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, cadastral maps, locations, and ownership details. The content focuses on land registration, title settlement, and property ownership determinations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
